title: DARPA AIxCC finals: autonomous systems found 54 of 63 synthetic vulnerabilities and 18 real ones
summary: In the final round of DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge, seven finalist cyber reasoning systems discovered 54 unique synthetic vulnerabilities across 63 challenges (86%, up from 37% at the semifinals) and patched 43 of them (68%, up from 25%), and they also found 18 real vulnerabilities in open-source C and Java codebases, for which they produced 11 patches now being disclosed to maintainers. Patch submissions took about 45 minutes and roughly $152 per task on average; Team Atlanta won the $4 million first prize, with Trail of Bits second and Theori third, and all seven systems are being released as open source, four of them on the announcement date.

actors.vendor: Team Atlanta; Trail of Bits; Theori (top three of seven finalist teams)
